content.text: Dark Burn Creative's whiteboard. Every project gets a lobby: its boards, files and feedback in one place, live for the whole team.
Briefs, references and first ideas, all on one board.
Plan the campaign, map the beats, pull the key art together.
Comments, votes and sign-off, without the email chain.
Press N, click anywhere and type. That's a sticky note.
Press C, then click this note to leave a comment.
Click Present at the top to walk these frames as slides.
This board is yours to play with. Edit, move or delete anything; Ctrl/Cmd + Z undoes it.
One question, ideas in clusters. The connectors are attached, so they follow when you move a theme.
Open on the boss fight. No logo for ten seconds.
One unbroken shot through the new map
Show the new co-op move up close
Tell it from the villain's side
Start at the ending, then rewind
Cut it from real player clips
Hide a code in the last frame
A small process map. Every arrow is attached at both ends: drag a step and its arrows follow.
Dashed arrows: the loop we only take when the client asks for changes.
Try it: drag Client review down. The arrows stay attached.
Need a step? Select a box and press Ctrl/Cmd + D.
One direction for the launch trailer: references, palette and type. Drop an image onto a slot and it fits the slot.
Plain words in sans, easy to read on a phone.
Ten minutes a column. Then start a vote from Voting to pick what to talk about first.
The client loved the first cut
Feedback in one place, not in email
Check these at the next retro
The keys worth learning first. On a Mac, Ctrl is Cmd and Alt is Option.
Edits sync live for everyone on the board. Before a big clean-up, save a checkpoint in History. Every other shortcut is in the main menu, under Keyboard shortcuts.
